title: Ill will turned back on its maker
literal_meaning: Whoever plans harm for another, Govinda plans harm for that person.
explanation: The verse warns against deliberately wishing or planning another person’s misfortune. It imagines that ill will being answered by Govinda. This is a religious moral warning, not a guarantee that every wrongdoer will suffer or that a person’s suffering proves wrongdoing.
meaning_odia: ଅନ୍ୟର ମନ୍ଦ ଚାହିଁବା ବା ମନ୍ଦ ଯୋଜନା କରିବାରୁ ପଦଟି ବାରଣ କରେ। ସେପରି ଲୋକର ମନ୍ଦ ଗୋବିନ୍ଦ ପାଞ୍ଚନ୍ତି ବୋଲି କହି ଏଥିରେ ଧାର୍ମିକ ଚେତାବନୀ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। କାହାର ଦୁଃଖ ଦେଖି ସେ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ କିଛି ଖରାପ କରିଥିଲା ବୋଲି ରାୟ ଦେବାର ଆଧାର ଏହା ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Someone proposes spreading a rumour to damage a rival’s chances, and a friend urges them to abandon the plan. (Original imagined occasion.)
cultural_context: Govinda is retained as the named divine figure in the source. The compilation supplies no separate explanation or attribution. The moral should not be converted into victim-blaming or a prediction of supernatural punishment.
odia_summary: ଅନ୍ୟର ମନ୍ଦ ପାଞ୍ଚିବା ବିରୋଧରେ ଗୋବିନ୍ଦଙ୍କ ନାମରେ ଏକ ନୈତିକ ଚେତାବନୀ।
english_summary: A religious warning against deliberately planning another person’s harm.
odia:
ଯେ ପାଞ୍ଚେ ପର ର ମନ୍ଦ
ତା ମନ୍ଦ ପାଞ୍ଚନ୍ତି ଗୋବିନ୍ଦ ।
